entry: Buy when the 2-period RSI closes at 5 or below.
Sell short when the 2-period RSI closes at 95 or above.
exit: Close a long when price closes above the 5-period SMA. Close a short when price closes below it.
stop_loss: No hard stop (following Connors). Risk 1% of capital per 1x ATR at entry.
filters: 200-period SMA trend filter: buys only when the close is above it, sells only when the close is below it.
